title: Omari Hardwick Says We Never Knew Ghost — Power Prequel or Movie Coming?
excerpt: Over five years after his on-screen death, Ghost remains a central figure in the Power universe. Now, Omari Hardwick says we never truly knew the real James St. Patrick—and he’s open to returning to explore the mysterious chapter before Power began. From early rivalries to untold family history, the door may be wide open for Ghost’s unfinished story.
